approaches.method: First Postnikov stage and stable-elements obstruction
approaches.result: Hyperfocal naturality; nilpotent-target existence/uniqueness; no pi_1 or ordinary mod-p stable-elements obstruction
approaches.gap: Higher target Postnikov-stage realization under the prescribed Sylow restriction

approaches.result: Homotopy-fixed-point section construction; every normal-Sylow-model source, including abelian S
approaches.gap: Fusion generated at proper essential subgroups is not one coprime automorphism action

approaches.result: Every fusion-preserving D8 endomorphism between the nine named D8/Sigma_4/A_6 pairs extends; complete finite morphism check
approaches.gap: No assertion for all D8 systems, larger groups, other targets or exotic systems

approaches.result: Centric-image plus lim^2 Z_phi=0 suffices; exact carry-cocycle control shows abelian 1-types alone are insufficient
approaches.gap: No general centric-image condition or lim^2 vanishing; no actual nonzero fusion obstruction

approaches.method: Destabilize the wreath extension by postcomposition
approaches.result: Diagonal BC_p -> B(C_p wr Sigma_n)^wedge_p has no homotopy retraction when p divides n
approaches.gap: Failure of the retraction method is not failure of the original extension
